This is module extends "website_sale_product_brand" to add brands as a filter on shop sidebar.

**Table of contents**

.. contents::
   :local:

Usage
=====

#. Go to Website Shop.
#. Select 'Customize' menu
#. Enable 'Product Attribute's Filters'
#. Enable 'Brands Filter'
